\tfsetsignature{III.brandt.thm:eisenstein-line}{GL2TF.Quat.eisenstein\_line}{fa550b86ef740453e0c8550c0f72ce051ba22fb0f7547193b68e6197ba4698ab}{∀ \{K : Type u\_1\} [inst : Field K] [inst\_1 : CharZero K] \{a b : ℤ\} \{D M : ℕ\} [inst\_2 : NeZero M]\tfbr{}  (O₀ : MaxOrder a b),\tfbr{}  RamifiedExactly a b D →\tfbr{}    ∀ (φ : LevelStructure (↑O₀) M) (s : Splitting K a b) (n : ℕ),\tfbr{}      0 < n →\tfbr{}        n.Coprime (D * M) →\tfbr{}          heckeOperator (eichlerOrder φ) n ↑(constantForm (eichlerOrder φ) s) =\tfbr{}              ↑((ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1) n) • ↑(constantForm (eichlerOrder φ) s) ∧\tfbr{}            (∀ f ∈ quatForms (eichlerOrder φ) s 2,\tfbr{}                weightedPairing (eichlerOrder φ) 2 f ↑(constantForm (eichlerOrder φ) s) = 0 →\tfbr{}                  weightedPairing (eichlerOrder φ) 2 (heckeOperator (eichlerOrder φ) n f)\tfbr{}                      ↑(constantForm (eichlerOrder φ) s) =\tfbr{}                    0) ∧\tfbr{}              ∀ f ∈ quatForms (eichlerOrder φ) s 2,\tfbr{}                ∃! c,\tfbr{}                  weightedPairing (eichlerOrder φ) 2 (f - c • ↑(constantForm (eichlerOrder φ) s))\tfbr{}                      ↑(constantForm (eichlerOrder φ) s) =\tfbr{}                    0}

\tfsetsignature{III.brandt.thm:hecke-multiplicative}{GL2TF.Quat.hecke\_multiplicative}{009dad91897b64387700fa1086ffafd4803a16fd8a60ebd79a48c1d5408d6009}{∀ \{K : Type u\_1\} [inst : Field K] [inst\_1 : CharZero K] \{a b : ℤ\} (O : QOrder a b)\tfbr{}  (s : Splitting K a b) (k m n : ℕ),\tfbr{}  0 < m →\tfbr{}    0 < n →\tfbr{}      m.Coprime n →\tfbr{}        (∃ (h₁ : HeckePair.IsHeckeFun ((normNSet O m).indicator 1)) (h₂ :\tfbr{}            HeckePair.IsHeckeFun ((normNSet O n).indicator 1)) (h₃ :\tfbr{}            HeckePair.IsHeckeFun ((normNSet O (m * n)).indicator 1)),\tfbr{}            ⟨(normNSet O m).indicator 1, h₁⟩ * ⟨(normNSet O n).indicator 1, h₂⟩ =\tfbr{}              ⟨(normNSet O (m * n)).indicator 1, h₃⟩) ∧\tfbr{}          ∀ f ∈ quatForms O s k,\tfbr{}            heckeOperator O m (heckeOperator O n f) = heckeOperator O (m * n) f ∧\tfbr{}              heckeOperator O n (heckeOperator O m f) = heckeOperator O (m * n) f}
\tfsetsignature{III.brandt.thm:hecke-neighbour-form}{GL2TF.Quat.hecke\_neighbour\_form}{5c9b8513ef80dd69fa5ca3ff74b2717e067ff92bea26382cea688078bc0a3a04}{∀ \{K : Type u\_1\} [inst : Field K] [inst\_1 : CharZero K] \{a b : ℤ\} (O : QOrder a b)\tfbr{}  (s : Splitting K a b) (k n : ℕ),\tfbr{}  0 < n →\tfbr{}    ∀ (x : (BHat a b)ˣ),\tfbr{}      (∀ y ∈ normNSet O n,\tfbr{}          finiteIdeleLattice O (x * y) ≤ finiteIdeleLattice O x ∧\tfbr{}            (finiteIdeleLattice O (x * y)).toAddSubgroup.relIndex\tfbr{}                (finiteIdeleLattice O x).toAddSubgroup =\tfbr{}              n \^{} 2) ∧\tfbr{}        (∀ y ∈ normNSet O n,\tfbr{}            ∀ y' ∈ normNSet O n,\tfbr{}              finiteIdeleLattice O (x * y) = finiteIdeleLattice O (x * y') ↔ ↑y = ↑y') ∧\tfbr{}          (∀ J ≤ finiteIdeleLattice O x,\tfbr{}              (∀ (y z : QuatAlg ℚ a b), y ∈ J → z ∈ O.toSubalgebra → y * z ∈ J) →\tfbr{}                (∀ (p : Nat.Primes),\tfbr{}                    ∃ β,\tfbr{}                      localLattice (↑p) J =\tfbr{}                        Submodule.map (LinearMap.mulLeft ℤ\_[↑p] ↑β)\tfbr{}                          (localLattice (↑p) (Subalgebra.toSubmodule O.toSubalgebra))) →\tfbr{}                  J.toAddSubgroup.relIndex (finiteIdeleLattice O x).toAddSubgroup = n \^{} 2 →\tfbr{}                    ∃ y ∈ normNSet O n, J = finiteIdeleLattice O (x * y)) ∧\tfbr{}            ∀ f ∈ quatForms O s k,\tfbr{}              ∀ (z x' : (BHat a b)ˣ) (γ : (QuatAlg ℚ a b)ˣ),\tfbr{}                finiteIdeleLattice O z =\tfbr{}                    Submodule.map (LinearMap.mulLeft ℤ ↑γ) (finiteIdeleLattice O x') →\tfbr{}                  f z = (splitRep s k ↑γ) (f x')}
\tfsetsignature{III.brandt.thm:hecke-recursion}{GL2TF.Quat.hecke\_recursion}{1bbc17c2434ccb54855ed9eac65e356a4ab14bace443470039a6825e7b53b310}{∀ \{K : Type u\_1\} [inst : Field K] [inst\_1 : CharZero K] \{a b : ℤ\} \{D M : ℕ\} [inst\_2 : NeZero M]\tfbr{}  (O₀ : MaxOrder a b),\tfbr{}  RamifiedExactly a b D →\tfbr{}    ∀ (φ : LevelStructure (↑O₀) M) (s : Splitting K a b) (k : ℕ),\tfbr{}      2 ≤ k →\tfbr{}        ∀ (p : ℕ),\tfbr{}          Nat.Prime p →\tfbr{}            ¬p ∣ D * M →\tfbr{}              ∀ (r : ℕ),\tfbr{}                1 ≤ r →\tfbr{}                  ∀ f ∈ quatForms (eichlerOrder φ) s k,\tfbr{}                    heckeOperator (eichlerOrder φ) p (heckeOperator (eichlerOrder φ) (p \^{} r) f) =\tfbr{}                      heckeOperator (eichlerOrder φ) (p \^{} (r + 1)) f +\tfbr{}                        ↑p \^{} (k - 1) • heckeOperator (eichlerOrder φ) (p \^{} (r - 1)) f}

\tfsetsignature{III.brandt.thm:hecke-trace-fixed-point}{GL2TF.Quat.hecke\_trace\_fixed\_point}{3909387b29c463b8b7e757ae882ea17bb7f975cfd7ef551b911e4a75db8b1406}{∀ \{K : Type u\_1\} [inst : Field K] [inst\_1 : CharZero K] \{a b : ℤ\},\tfbr{}  a < 0 →\tfbr{}    b < 0 →\tfbr{}      ∀ (O : QOrder a b) (s : Splitting K a b) (k n : ℕ),\tfbr{}        2 ≤ k →\tfbr{}          0 < n →\tfbr{}            ∃ T,\tfbr{}              (∀ (f : ↥(quatForms O s k)), ↑(T f) = heckeOperator O n ↑f) ∧\tfbr{}                (LinearMap.trace K ↥(quatForms O s k)) T =\tfbr{}                  ∑ᶠ (c : classSet O),\tfbr{}                    (↑(Nat.card ↥(classStabilizer (orderCompletionUnits O) (Quotient.out c))))⁻¹ *\tfbr{}                      ∑ᶠ (γ : QuatAlg ℚ a b) (\_ :\tfbr{}                        (finEmbed a b) γ ∈\tfbr{}                            (fun y => ↑(Quotient.out c) * y * ↑(Quotient.out c)⁻¹) ''\tfbr{}                              ↑(latticeCompletion (Subalgebra.toSubmodule O.toSubalgebra)) ∧\tfbr{}                          nrd γ = ↑n),\tfbr{}                        heckePolyRing k ↑(trd γ) ↑n}
